verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe starting Codex in a repository to 'explore unfamiliar code' and using subagents to delegate exploration work, which supports autonomous codebase mapping without manual file selection; community feedback also notes strong agentic performance in some cases. However, there's no dedicated documentation of a codebase-mapping/explain feature (e.g., architecture summaries, dependency graphs) and some community reports call agentic reasoning weak. Missing for 10: dedicated codebase-map/explain feature documentation, independent hands-on verification of full-repo comprehension without file hints, and resolution of mixed community quality reports.
